goalTranslation.businessGoal: every agent CLI the platform spawns leaves behind a verifiable, bounded run receipt instead of an unaccountable side effect

quantifiedTarget.rationale: runAgent (src/lib/agent-run.mjs) writes receipt.json and report.html atomically and renames the run directory into place; a run that produced no receipt does not exist as a run

tiers.action: spawn an agent CLI with shell:false and capture bounded stdout/stderr into a run receipt (src/lib/agent-run.mjs execute)

advance an execution-graph external-write node: src/lib/execution-graph.mjs refuses any graph whose external-write node lacks an upstream HUMAN_GATE barrier, and a HUMAN_GATE event is only accepted from a human actor

interception.how: spawn failures are normalized in src/lib/agent-run.mjs (normalizeProcessError): errno code plus the first line of the message, capped at 200 characters, never a stack; stdout/stderr are capped at 262144 bytes per stream by createBoundedCapture. No retry block is declared because no retry-with-backoff loop exists in this repo: execution-graph maximumAttempts is a bounded re-attempt allowance driven by recorded events, not an automatic retry.

fallback.description: a failed or timed-out run still writes receipt.json and a static report.html carrying status failed/timeout, the normalized process error, captured bounded stderr, and the lifecycle events; nothing is retried silently and nothing is hidden

context.noneRationale: there is no LLM provider call site in this repo; src/lib/agent-run.mjs spawns agent CLI processes and never assembles a prompt, so there is no context to compress. The budget above is AGENT_RUN_LIMITS.outputBytes — 262144 BYTES retained per output stream, not tokens; no tokenizer exists here to count tokens, and declaring a token number would invent one.

slos.rationale: enforced rather than observed: AGENT_RUN_LIMITS.timeoutMaxMs caps every run's timeout budget, and the timeout timer aborts then SIGKILLs the child (src/lib/agent-run.mjs execute)
AGENT_RUN_LIMITS.outputBytes, enforced by createBoundedCapture; the receipt records the truncation

atomic write plus rename in runAgent; the two golden rate metrics are deliberately absent because no measurement pipeline exists in this repo to observe them, and a rate nothing measures is an invented guard
